info.title: SBIR / STTR Phase I–III Technical Volume & Commercialization Plan API
info.description: Stateless AI R&D Proposal & IP Compliance API that converts R&D technical specifications and SBIR/STTR solicitation topics into a DoD/AFWERX/SpaceWERX/NSF/NASA SBIR/STTR Technical Work Plan, TRL 1–9 progression matrix, Phase III Dual-Use Commercialization & Transition Plan (15 U.S.C. § 638(r)(4)), and pre-award DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20 SBIR Data Rights assertions.

get.description: Lightweight health check endpoint for uptime monitoring and RapidAPI status checks.

post.description: Converts R&D specs and an SBIR/STTR topic description into a DoD/AFWERX/NSF SBIR/STTR Technical Work Plan, TRL 1–9 progression matrix, Phase III Dual-Use Commercialization & Transition Plan, and DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20 SBIR Data Rights assertions.

example.sbir_sttr_topic_and_rd_specs: Solicitation: AF262-D014 (Direct-to-Phase II AFWERX / SpaceWERX Open Topic). Objective: Develop and demonstrate an autonomous edge-AI tactical spectrum sensing and anti-jamming cognitive radio waveform for contested C5ISR environments. Must demonstrate TRL 6 prototype in relevant tactical environment within 15 months, include a signed Phase III Customer Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) pathway with PEO C3BM, and provide a dual-use commercialization strategy alongside a DFARS 252.227-7018 SBIR Data Rights schedule.
example.company_technology_and_ip_baseline: AegisWave Photonics & AI Lab (Small Business, 42 employees) has developed a proprietary sub-millisecond neural blind-signal classifier and FPGA cognitive frequency-hopping core tested at TRL 4 in laboratory anechoic trials using $1.8M in private seed venture capital. Commercial dual-use market includes 5G/6G private industrial wireless interference mitigation and low-Earth-orbit (LEO) commercial satcom ground terminals.
example.sponsoring_agency: Department of Defense (AFWERX / SpaceWERX / PEO C3BM)

200.description: Successfully generated SBIR/STTR Technical Work Plan, TRL Matrix, Commercialization Plan & DFARS 252.227-7018 Data Rights.

sbir_sttr_topic_and_rd_specs.description: Full or excerpted DoD, AFWERX, SPACEWERX, Navy, Army, DARPA, NSF, NASA, or DHS SBIR/STTR topic instructions, Phase I/II/III technical objectives, and evaluation criteria.

company_technology_and_ip_baseline.description: Summary of the small business offeror's R&D technology, current TRL, Principal Investigator (PI) credentials, prior IRAD/patents, STTR university/lab partner (if applicable), and dual-use commercial traction.

sponsoring_agency.description: Optional sponsoring federal agency or SBIR/STTR directorate.

milestone_title.description: Concise technical R&D milestone title aligned with the SBIR/STTR topic objectives.

starting_trl_to_target_trl.description: Technology Readiness Level (TRL) advancement achieved during this milestone.

technical_objectives_and_r_and_d_methodo.description: Detailed scientific/engineering methodology, risk reduction experiments, architecture, and Principal Investigator (PI) execution plan.

quantifiable_exit_criteria_and_deliverab.description: Measurable technical KPPs/metrics and contract deliverable.

technical_data_or_computer_software_item.description: Specific technical data, algorithm, model weight, firmware, or computer software component to be delivered with restrictions.

basis_for_assertion.description: Statutory basis for the data rights assertion under DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20.

asserted_rights_category.description: Specific asserted license rights category protecting the offeror's IP during Phase I, II, and Phase III.

name_of_person_asserting_restrictions.description: Legal entity name of the small business concern or research institution asserting the restriction.

sbir_pwin_and_transition_readiness_score.description: 0-100 score evaluating technical merit, TRL feasibility, dual-use commercialization potential, and Phase III Program-of-Record transition readiness.

recommended_phase_and_transition_pathway.description: Strategic SBIR/STTR pursuit and transition recommendation.

executive_technical_and_dual_use_summary.description: Executive summary of the R&D innovation, warfighter/agency operational impact, and commercial dual-use market thesis.

trl_progression_and_technical_work_plan.description: Structured Phase I/II Technical Work Plan and TRL 1-9 progression milestones with quantifiable exit criteria.

dfars_252_227_7018_sbir_data_rights_asse.description: Pre-populated DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20 SBIR/STTR Data Rights Assertion Table protecting core IP for 20 years.

phase_iii_dual_use_commercialization_and.description: Complete, paste-ready SBIR/STTR Volume 2 Technical Work Plan & Commercialization Plan narrative including Customer Memorandum (MOU) justification, TAM/SAM/SOM dual-use revenue forecast, and 15 U.S.C. § 638(r)(4) Phase III sole-source transition roadmap.
